name: ai-chat
title: AI chat
description: A full chat with an AI story assistant made only with mangacn: a header with the assistant's name, a model switch (Button Group of pressed buttons that drops a Marker in the conversation) and New chat; the conversation in the Message Scroller with Message + Bubble lines (your own in ink bubbles, the assistant's in paper bubbles), Markers ("Today", "Switched to a faster model"), the reasoning folded in a Collapsible that opens a thought SpeechBubble ("Thought for 4 s"), tool steps in a Trace (done checks, a running Spinner), a Code Block, Reaction Picker chips, Attachments on a user line, an offered Questionnaire ("Plan your one-shot") that folds into a summary card, and an error shouted in an accent shout SpeechBubble with Retry. The composer: Attachments row (uploading line, remove action), attach button, Textarea (Enter sends, Shift+Enter new line), send button that shows the loading lines while the assistant answers. Sending plays a fake reply with no network: a running step, the waiting dots, then the answer types in a TypingBubble. From 48rem wide it is a 48rem frame that scrolls inside; narrower it follows the page (no inner scroller) and sending brings the composer back into view. Works in light, dark, any accent and at phone width.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/blocks/ai-chat". The replies are fake (timers, no network): replace send() with your own call and stream the text into the TypingBubble. From 48rem wide the chat is a 48rem-tall frame; narrower it follows the page, with no inner scroller.

meta.tagline: Thinking in a thought bubble, errors shouted, answers typed as they come.
